body:
#2751 is RULED TO SHIP. No further re-review is coming: stop waiting.

The round-2 attested review at a2e163b106 confirmed F1 (the verify authority regression) is fixed, and the policy and dispatch parity audits are clean. Its remaining blocking items are AC4-completeness only. Under the 2-round cap they are deferred to slice 3, TASK-1940 (approved; implements STORY-1728); STORY-1728 stays open until TASK-1940 lands. The operator has cleared the PR-2751 hold.

One thing left: main moved one commit, 6d590ed914 (BUG-1985, #2753). It overlaps agent_launch.rs, compete_cmd.rs, doctor_cmd.rs, pr_cmd.rs and upgrade_release.rs.
1. Merge origin/main into story-1728-slice2b and resolve any conflicts. In your migrated modules, keep main's BUG-1985 semantics: fail-closed status, the shallow dirty probe and status_output_says_rebasing in pr_cmd.rs.
2. Run check-ci-fast, check-ci-compile and named filters: story_1728, bug_1985, pr_cmd.
3. Push and reply here with the SHA. I'll ship on green CI. Don't merge or ship it yourself.
subject: #2751 ships: merge main (BUG-1985) and push
